sourceTitle: Muse Is Now Available in Australia: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
originalTitle: Muse Is Now Available in Australia: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
author: shefali2018

blocks.text: Muse is a personal AI agent. It doesn’t just answer questions, it actually does the work. It helps people stay on top of things, takes tasks and projects off their plate, and turns long-term goals into action plans.
blocks.zh: Muse 是一个个人智能体。它不仅回答问题，还能实际完成工作。它帮助人们井井有条地处理事务，接手他们的任务和项目，并将长期目标转化为行动计划。
blocks.en: Muse is a personal AI agent. It doesn’t just answer questions, it actually does the work. It helps people stay on top of things, takes tasks and projects off their plate, and turns long-term goals into action plans.

blocks.text: Muse is available in Australia from today, with local connector experiences across creativity, shopping, property, fitness and entertainment rolling out progressively.
blocks.zh: Muse 从今天起在澳大利亚上线，涵盖创意、购物、房产、健身和娱乐等本地连接器体验将逐步推出。
blocks.en: Muse is available in Australia from today, with local connector experiences across creativity, shopping, property, fitness and entertainment rolling out progressively.

blocks.text: Meta built Muse from the ground up to be a safe, secure, private, and widely available personal AI agent.
blocks.zh: Meta 从零开始打造 Muse，旨在使其成为一个安全、可靠、私密且广泛可用的个人智能体。
blocks.en: Meta built Muse from the ground up to be a safe, secure, private, and widely available personal AI agent.

blocks.text: Each person stays in control of their Muse and decides how much access it gets.
blocks.zh: 每个人都能掌控自己的 Muse，并决定它拥有多少访问权限。
blocks.en: Each person stays in control of their Muse and decides how much access it gets.

blocks.text: Following our global announcement of Muse, we are excited to share that Muse is now available in Australia.
blocks.zh: 继我们在全球发布 Muse 之后，我们很高兴地宣布 Muse 现已在澳大利亚上线。
blocks.en: Following our global announcement of Muse, we are excited to share that Muse is now available in Australia.

blocks.text: What Muse can do in Australia
blocks.zh: Muse 在澳大利亚能做些什么
blocks.en: What Muse can do in Australia

blocks.text: Connectors are a big reason Muse can do so much. People in Australia can connect their Muse to apps and services they already use, such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Instagram and OpenTable, so it can help them manage emails, coordinate schedules, draw on saved content and make a restaurant reservation—all part of getting everyday tasks done.
blocks.zh: 连接器是 Muse 能完成如此多任务的重要原因。澳大利亚的用户可以将 Muse 连接到他们已在使用的应用和服务，例如 Gmail、Google Calendar、Instagram 和 OpenTable，从而帮助管理电子邮件、协调日程、利用已保存的内容以及预订餐厅——这些都是完成日常任务的一部分。
blocks.en: Connectors are a big reason Muse can do so much. People in Australia can connect their Muse to apps and services they already use, such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Instagram and OpenTable, so it can help them manage emails, coordinate schedules, draw on saved content and make a restaurant reservation—all part of getting everyday tasks done.

blocks.text: Early local connector partners in Australia include Canva, Domain, Kogan, MECCA, Officeworks, realestate.com.au, SWEAT, ShopBack, and Ticketek. Connector features will roll out progressively, with some experiences becoming available after launch. Canva, the global all-in-one visual communication platform that empowers anyone to design, is also available as a connector for Muse users around the world.
blocks.zh: 澳大利亚早期本地连接器合作伙伴包括 Canva、Domain、Kogan、MECCA、Officeworks、realestate.com.au、SWEAT、ShopBack 和 Ticketek。连接器功能将逐步推出，部分体验将在发布后开放。Canva 是赋能任何人进行设计的全球一体化视觉传播平台，也作为连接器面向全球 Muse 用户开放。
blocks.en: Early local connector partners in Australia include Canva, Domain, Kogan, MECCA, Officeworks, realestate.com.au, SWEAT, ShopBack, and Ticketek. Connector features will roll out progressively, with some experiences becoming available after launch. Canva, the global all-in-one visual communication platform that empowers anyone to design, is also available as a connector for Muse users around the world.

blocks.text: As these experiences become available, you could ask Muse to to design any visuals or content you need with Canva, explore property listings on Domain and realestate.com.au, or work towards fitness goals with SWEAT. You could also buy great value electronics and appliances through Kogan.com, beauty products through MECCA, school and office supplies through Officeworks, or tickets through Ticketek. With ShopBack, you could compare prices and earn cashback and rewards on flights, hotels and shopping.
blocks.zh: 随着这些体验逐步开放，你可以让 Muse 使用 Canva 设计你需要的任何视觉素材或内容，在 Domain 和 realestate.com.au 上浏览房源信息，或通过 SWEAT 朝着健身目标努力。你还可以通过 Kogan.com 购买高性价比的电子产品和家电，通过 MECCA 购买美容产品，通过 Officeworks 购买学校与办公用品，或通过 Ticketek 购买门票。借助 ShopBack，你可以比较价格，并在机票、酒店和购物上赚取返现和奖励。
blocks.en: As these experiences become available, you could ask Muse to to design any visuals or content you need with Canva, explore property listings on Domain and realestate.com.au, or work towards fitness goals with SWEAT. You could also buy great value electronics and appliances through Kogan.com, beauty products through MECCA, school and office supplies through Officeworks, or tickets through Ticketek. With ShopBack, you could compare prices and earn cashback and rewards on flights, hotels and shopping.

blocks.zh: 更多使用 Muse 的方式

blocks.text: Real time conversations with your Muse are now possible on mobile, web or Mac. With voice, you can talk through an idea with your Muse and let it take shape without worrying about the exact prompt. Just tap the phone icon in the top-right corner to start talking.
blocks.zh: 现在，你可以在手机、网页或 Mac 上与你的 Muse 进行实时对话。通过语音，你可以与 Muse 讨论一个想法，让它逐渐成形，而不必担心提示词是否精确。只需点击右上角的电话图标即可开始交谈。
blocks.en: Real time conversations with your Muse are now possible on mobile, web or Mac. With voice, you can talk through an idea with your Muse and let it take shape without worrying about the exact prompt. Just tap the phone icon in the top-right corner to start talking.

blocks.text: Spaces, a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea, is now also available. Spaces can help you get things done, have a little fun, or give your creative projects a home, whether it’s a shopping hub, school dashboard, wedding planner, or trip planner to name a few ideas.
blocks.zh: Spaces 是你在 Muse 中通过描述想法来创建的定制体验，现在也已推出。Spaces 可以帮助你完成任务、带来一点乐趣，或为你的创意项目提供一个空间，无论是购物中心、学校仪表盘、婚礼策划还是旅行规划，这只是几个例子。
blocks.en: Spaces, a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea, is now also available. Spaces can help you get things done, have a little fun, or give your creative projects a home, whether it’s a shopping hub, school dashboard, wedding planner, or trip planner to name a few ideas.

blocks.text: Built to be private, safe and secure
blocks.zh: 以隐私、安全和保障为设计核心
blocks.en: Built to be private, safe and secure

blocks.text: Making this technology work for everyone requires careful design and engineering to operate more safely. That’s where most of the effort on this project went and this post explains our approach in detail. Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated computer in the cloud that securely stores the data and credentials for the services you connect, while keeping passwords and payment methods out of the agent’s view. You choose what your Muse can access, and it checks with you before sensitive actions such as sending an email or making a purchase.
blocks.zh: 让这项技术为每个人服务需要精心的设计和工程，以更安全地运行。这个项目的大部分精力都投入在这方面，这篇文章详细解释了我们的做法。Muse 运行在 Muse Secure VM 上，这是云中的一台专用计算机，可安全存储你连接的服务的数据和凭据，同时让密码和支付方式不进入智能体的视野。你可以选择 Muse 可访问的内容，并且在进行发送邮件或购物等敏感操作之前，它会先征得你的同意。
blocks.en: Making this technology work for everyone requires careful design and engineering to operate more safely. That’s where most of the effort on this project went and this post explains our approach in detail. Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated computer in the cloud that securely stores the data and credentials for the services you connect, while keeping passwords and payment methods out of the agent’s view. You choose what your Muse can access, and it checks with you before sensitive actions such as sending an email or making a purchase.

blocks.text: Will Easton, Managing Director, Meta Australia and New Zealand, said: “With the festive season coming up, the timing couldn’t be better. From finding and buying the perfect gift to planning and booking a holiday, Muse is designed to take work off Australians’ plates. As local experiences roll out, familiar services will make Muse even more useful in everyday life. And people stay in control, including choosing what Muse can access and approving purchases before they happen.”
blocks.zh: Meta 澳大利亚和新西兰董事总经理 Will Easton 表示：“随着节日季的到来，这个时机再好不过了。从寻找和购买完美礼物到规划和预订假期，Muse 旨在减轻澳大利亚人的负担。随着本地化体验的推出，熟悉的服务将使 Muse 在日常生活中更加有用。而且人们始终掌握控制权，包括选择 Muse 可访问的内容，并在购买发生前进行批准。”
blocks.en: Will Easton, Managing Director, Meta Australia and New Zealand, said: “With the festive season coming up, the timing couldn’t be better. From finding and buying the perfect gift to planning and booking a holiday, Muse is designed to take work off Australians’ plates. As local experiences roll out, familiar services will make Muse even more useful in everyday life. And people stay in control, including choosing what Muse can access and approving purchases before they happen.”

blocks.text: Muse is available in Australia on iOS, Android, and muse.ai, a Mac app, and coming soon to AI glasses. It’s free for most of what people need, with subscription plans for people who want to do more.
blocks.zh: Muse 现已在澳大利亚的 iOS、Android 和 muse.ai（Mac 应用）上推出，并将很快登陆 AI 眼镜。对大多数人所需的功能免费，并为想要做更多事情的人提供订阅计划。
blocks.en: Muse is available in Australia on iOS, Android, and muse.ai, a Mac app, and coming soon to AI glasses. It’s free for most of what people need, with subscription plans for people who want to do more.
